info.name: OS Management Hub Scheduled Job API
Gets a list of all scheduled jobs in a compartment

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The OCID of the compartment that contains the resources to list. This filter returns only resources contained within the specified compartment.

params.name: displayName
params.description: A filter to return resources that match the given user-friendly name.

params.name: displayNameContains
params.description: A filter to return resources that may partially match the given display name.

params.name: lifecycleState
params.description: A filter to return only scheduled jobs currently in the given state.

params.name: managedInstanceId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance. This filter returns resources associated with this managed instance.

params.name: managedInstanceGroupId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance group. This filter returns resources associated with this group.

params.name: managedCompartmentId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed compartment. This filter returns resources associated with this compartment.

params.name: lifecycleStageId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the lifecycle stage. This resource returns resources associated with this lifecycle stage.

params.name: operationType
params.description: A filter to return only scheduled jobs with the given operation type.

params.name: scheduleType
params.description: A filter to return only scheduled jobs of the given scheduling type (one-time or recurring).

params.name: timeStart
params.description:
A filter to return only resources with a date on or after the given value, in ISO 8601 format.

Example: 2017-07-14T02:40:00.000Z

params.name: timeEnd
params.description:
A filter to return only resources with a date on or before the given value, in ISO 8601 format.

Example: 2017-07-14T02:40:00.000Z

params.name: limit
params.description:
For list pagination. The maximum number of results per page, or items to return in a paginated "List" call.
For important details about how pagination works, see [List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

Example: `50`

params.name: page
params.description:
For list pagination. The value of the `opc-next-page` response header from the previous "List" call.
For important details about how pagination works, see [List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

Example: `3`

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'ASC' or 'DESC'.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided. Default order for timeCreated is descending. Default order for displayName is ascending.

params.name: isRestricted
params.description: A filter to return only restricted scheduled jobs.

params.name: id
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the scheduled job. A filter to return the specified job.

params.name: compartmentIdInSubtree
params.description: Indicates whether to include subcompartments in the returned results. Default is false.

params.name: location
params.description: A filter to return only resources whose location matches the given value.

params.name: locationNotEqualTo
params.description: A filter to return only resources whose location does not match the given value.

params.name: isManagedByAutonomousLinux
params.description: Indicates whether to list only resources managed by the Autonomous Linux service.

params.name: dynamicSetId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the dynamic set. This filter returns resources associated with this dynamic set.

items.docs: Lists scheduled jobs that match the specified compartment or scheduled job [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm).

params.name: scheduledJobId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the scheduled job.

info.name: Triggers a scheduled job to execute immediately

params.name: scheduledJobId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the scheduled job.

items.docs:
Triggers an already created recurring scheduled job to run immediately instead of waiting for its next regularly
scheduled time. This operation only applies to recurring jobs, not one-time scheduled jobs.
